_comment: Known-benign noise for tools/ui-shots/sweep.mjs. `console`/`responses` are regexes (case-insensitive) matched against a console message's text or a failed response's URL. `smallTextSelectors` are CSS selectors (not regexes) exempting matching elements from the small-text (<12px) check -- see docs/UI-LOOP.md, 'The allowlist'. Keep this list to genuinely expected, understood noise: everything else the old (pre-WP0/WP1/...) UI produces is the pass-00 baseline, on purpose: it is meant to be high, and every later pass should shrink it. `smallTextSelectors` is empty as of 2026-09-12: it held the compact tab bar's 12px labels, and the web bar has no labels any more -- four glyphs and a hamburger.
